title: Category View Concentration
scenario: Find articles that account for > 50% of their category's total monthly views.
tableSchema: articles (article_id INT, category_id INT), page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT)
hint: Calculate total views per category/month, then partition.
correctQuery: SELECT article_id FROM (SELECT article_id, SUM(views_count)::NUMERIC / SUM(SUM(views_count)) OVER(PARTITION BY category_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', view_date)) as pct FROM articles JOIN page_views USING (article_id) GROUP BY article_id, category_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', view_date)) t WHERE pct > 0.5;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, category_id INT); CREATE TABLE page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT);
